source_note: The base commit plus the retained compound source fixture support; command behavior was unchanged for the initial capture.
notes: One completed owned private-Xvfb Rhino session with a 2400-second deadline; no user-owned desktop/session interaction. Subsequent checks replay saved observations without launching Rhino.

Both engines used the same native-generated 3DM sources. Export validates a native definition/sample round trip. The public Rhino Cap probe rejects document insertion changes to its recorded source, snapshots EndCommand, and restores selection/layers/groups while deleting only owned objects.

24 negative-volume X-separated cases and four reversed zero-volume cases distinguish spatial sense from the former total signed-volume rule. The exact classifier now supplies global reversal where supported, not independent component normalization.

Four coincident-opposed sources remain topology differences: native 12 faces/24 edges/solid/zero volume versus Rhino 11 faces/32 edges/open/no volume. Full raw observations and unfiltered before/after comparison reports are retained.

The 96 ordinary outputs have independent box area/volume witnesses; input vertex multisets, input areas and output document state are also checked. All 140 earlier ordinary Cap command records still match.

Comparison includes spatial edge definitions/domains/samples, physical vertices, oriented loop incidence, areas, volume, solid/manifold flags, identity, attributes, groups and selection. It does not compare generated cap UV frames, surface coefficients/domains, loop starts or face insertion order.

Compaction was recursively verified against the raw capture, including IEEE-754 numeric bit patterns and negative zero. Baseline native response is hashed here; the retained source recipe and historical command commit reproduce it.

Unknown multi-component orientation preserves face sense with an explicit command warning. Unknown single-component orientation retains approximate volume normalization, not an exact certificate or self-intersection validation. General document insertion/replacement normalization remains unimplemented.
All command timing fields are zero; this is correctness evidence, not a performance benchmark.
